annotations.title: Build and publish a Krate app

description: Builds a real app the person keeps: one small file that runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux and opens from a link in any browser, phones included. A Krate app keeps its own data on the device and works offline; with the person's permission it can print to a printer they pick with no print dialog, talk to serial and USB devices, read and write Excel files, serve other devices on the local network, and use the camera, microphone and location. Compiles the app's files (Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, manifest.toml and any assets), checks it uses only Krate's API and runs it once, then publishes it unlisted to the signed-in person's Krate account with its link. Answers a build id at once; a build takes a few minutes. Needs the person to sign in to Krate.
